description: Hi — this is a good fit for a bounded one-day WordPress implementation because your layout is already designed and WordPress is installed. I can reproduce the supplied layout as a responsive one-page build, create the contact form with spam/CAPTCHA protection, store submissions in WordPress for export, route administrator notifications and visitor confirmations, then verify the page on desktop/mobile before hand-off. I’d keep the implementation maintainable rather than mixing multiple builders unless your existing site specifically requires WPBakery or Elementor. D’AUBE SONNTAG’s relevant evidence is our own web, UX and QA product/system work; I won’t present internal D’AUBE work as past client history. My bid is $89 fixed with a 1-day target, assuming the supplied design/assets are complete and the scope remains one page plus the described form. Custom integrations, new copy/design direction, or unrelated site changes would be handled as a separate change order rather than hidden inside the fixed price. After award, I’d first confirm which builder is already standard on the installation and the exact form fields/CAPTCHA option you prefer.
evidence_policy: D'AUBE-owned internal/product-system work only; no fabricated WordPress/client history
scope_guard: one supplied-layout WordPress page + responsive implementation + standard contact fields + CAPTCHA/spam protection + dashboard entry storage/export + visitor/admin email notifications + desktop/mobile QA + handoff; excludes new branding/copy, custom integrations, multi-page expansion and paid plugin purchases
